drivers: Four attributes vary simultaneously (count, shape, fill, rotation) with 3 to be inferred, high working-memory load
Rules are standard and simple individually (minus-one progression, 45° decrement, distribution of shape/fill), rows are consistent
Distractors systematically vary count, fill and rotation so a single missed rule yields a wrong option
Rotation rule requires row-wise progression ending at 'upright' (0°) which differs from the 45° values seen in columns 3 of rows 1-2; 105 s is adequate but not generous
